notes.title: No more halloween :(
notes.content:
I honestly think I like the Halloween look MORE than the original look for the game but oh well, see ya next year

-Changes to qte times will remain the same, 3 seconds to respond instead of 2!

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Hello! 
The Don't Get Distracted Halloween event is OUT right now!
                                                                       [u]with a nice 20% off[/u]

-I made the game a little easier (upped the response time from 2-3 seconds for qtes)

-I changed the look of the entire game to fit the Halloween vibe!

-I added spooky ambient audio and 1 new narrator track all about Halloween! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42382096/a2dfc0903fa658cad0137ee08653d991658fa6e7.png[/img]


The Halloween update and discount (I DONT THINK THEY'LL LET ME DISCOUNT IT THAT LONG I WILL TRY MY BEST) will last until the [b]20th OF NOVEMBER![/b]

Other notable fixes:
-removed end game guess feature (too hard)
-made it so overlapping QTEs are less likely (still can happen but are much less likely now)
-lowered death audio a little

notes.title: Don't Get Distracted Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Hey! Don't Get Distracted will be celebrating Halloween this year during the [u]Steam Scream Fest![/u]

Here's a list of stuff I added for the Halloween update!


[b]-Mood lighting![/b] (very orange)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42382096/a2801f16f34a0e209b1ac332171ed1e1e0aca184.png[/img]


[b]-Murf-o-Lanterns! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42382096/1f5bbd58097f603f6d71790ae7d76d4232f51ccc.png[/img]


[b]-Bats on strings that spin and have glowing eyes![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42382096/47dc1328f133c177b6affc2261680b71a2aea308.png[/img]


[b]-New ambient audio and 1 new Narrator track![/b]

-During the Scream Fest there will be a [b][u]20% discount[/u][/b] off of the game!


I hope everyone enjoys the spooky atmosphere!

For those curious I am currently working on adding keybinding as an option, as well as working on a new game (no details out yet but its gonna be funny and a non rage game!)

You can follow me on twitter for future updates! [url=https://twitter.com/GamesByMurf]My twitter![/url]


The Scream Fest lasts October 25th to November 1st!

The DGD Halloween update and discount (maybe not discount steam is a hater) will last from October 19th to the 20th of NOVEMBER
